blockers: Signal identity remains TRUSTED_UNVERIFIED; the pinned fingerprint mitigates drift but out-of-band safety-number verification has not been performed, so the live channel cannot yet be trusted for 2FA or operator instructions.
Live inbound Signal receive and live 2FA are untested because they require an operator message/code; the primary Comms-01 function is therefore unproven end-to-end.
major_findings: Deployed controller/adapter hashes and a pre-change archive hash were reported, but no path-to-hash mapping proved all tracked files equal the deployed artifacts.
The acceptance hash was unsigned and read over the same socket affected by the change; no append-only or tamper-evident chain was described.
ArtifactStore containment lacked explicit symlink escape, traversal and outside-root manifest coverage.
Lease/retry semantics lacked tests for expiry during work, partial-success retry idempotency and heartbeat loss.
Omitting account has ambiguity risk if a second account is ever registered.
0660 sockets rely on group membership and protocol checks; peer credentials and negative authorization evidence were not cited.
minor_findings: Hermes runtime isolation lacked stale-socket and cross-service restart evidence.
Compileall did not prove systemd-context imports.
Bounded daemon errors lacked stated bounds, backoff and exhaustion alerting.
Test coverage was unquantified and not explicitly run against deployed units.
required_tests: Hash tracked controller.py, controller_socket.py, top_delivery_controller.py and adapter against deployed paths and archive the mapping.
ArtifactStore symlink, traversal, absolute-path and outside-root tests.
Signal daemon restart during receive, duplicate receiver, second-account state and bounded-error exhaustion tests.
Lease expiry, retry idempotency and heartbeat-loss tests.
Socket negative authorization tests and owner/group assertions.
Hermes concurrent restart and runtime-directory isolation test.
required_operator_actions: Perform out-of-band Signal safety-number verification and record the fingerprint.
Send a live inbound message and complete one live 2FA round trip.
Countersign or store the acceptance and deployment hashes outside the mutable Comms-01 root.
rationale: The isolated scope and no-broker/no-production mutation posture are sound. Conditional approval remains appropriate until identity trust and live receive/2FA are witnessed, and the evidence-chain, hash-equivalence, containment and lease/retry tests are recorded.
